build.native: Both Rust SDKs use Bazel -c opt and SDK-scoped cross-crate ThinLTO; both C++ consumers Release -O3.
build.comparator: Pinned upstream release, opt-level=z, full LTO, one codegen unit. Bootstrap/workloads compiled with Hermes -O.
build.clock: Same high-resolution steady_clock __now() hook; full TS suite also uses __now().

benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-rtf-text-buffer-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case '' /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc
 run_case tag /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc
 run_case size /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc
 run_case locale /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case constructor /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc
 run_case relative /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case full /tmp/hermes-all-api-optimized.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case edges /tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-edge-control.js
done
profileScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
sdk=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-exact-decimal-hires
host=/tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-hires
for smoke in "$sdk"/js/*-smoke.js; do
 case "$smoke" in *datetimeformat-smoke.js) "$host" /tmp/hermes-list-default-datetime-smoke.js ;; *) "$host" "$smoke" ;; esac
done
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-rtf-text-buffer-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-hires; fi
 for label in format decimal; do
  if [ "$label" = format ]; then workload=relative-format-profile.js; else workload=relative-decimal-profile.js; fi
  taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-$label-$variant.cpuprofile" "benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension/$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-$label-$variant-profile.log" 2>&1
 done
 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-clock-$variant.json"
done
bash /tmp/hermes-exact-decimal-run.sh
order: Three rounds, CPU0 pinned for every host; before/after/magrinj in rounds1+3, reverse in round2. Full14 native/TS suite on before/after in three rounds, reverse round2. No concurrent builds/profiles during timing. Profiles collected separately first. Five source-only numeric edge cases follow on native before/after, three alternating rounds.
